title: Privacy Policy
intro: We take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use our online tools.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We do not collect, store, or transmit any of your personal data. All tools run entirely in your browser, and your data never leaves your device.

localProcessing.title: Local Processing
localProcessing.content: All data processing happens locally in your browser. We do not have access to any information you input into our tools.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We may use essential cookies for basic functionality such as language preferences. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We do not share your data with any third-party services. Our tools are designed to work completely offline once loaded.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us.
